title: eBay | How To | Introduction to the eBay Community Platform
description: Introducing the eBay Community! A Peer to Peer support community for the eBay site that is live 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. The eBay Community Platform provides a place for community members or participants to search for information, read and post about topics of interest, and learn from each other along the way. To get to the eBay Community go to community.ebay.com. eBay YouTube Customer Support Hours are Monday – Friday, 6:00AM – 6:00PM PST. For help outside these hours, please contact eBay Customer Service at http://ebay.to/2iXYNIC

asr.full_text: Hi! My name is Alan from the eBay Community Team, and I'm here today to give you a brief introduction to the eBay Community platform. The eBay Community is a peer-to-peer support community that is live 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. We have a great mix of participants. You'll find everyone from new buyers and sellers, right up to members who've been selling on eBay for over twenty years. We have a dedicated eBay Community team that joins in conversation, as well as eBay employees from across the company with expert knowledge participating in the Community. To get to the eBay community go to community.ebay.com. Thanks for watching and stay tuned for more How To videos to help you get the most out of your eBay Community experience.
